newsitem.title: USA: Capitol Transamerica declares stock split. [CORRECTED 20:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Capitol Transamerica declares stock split. [CORRECTED 20:44 GMT]

text.p: Capitol Transamerica Corp said its board of directors Thursday declared a three-for-two stock split.

The company said there will be 11.4 million common shares outstanding after the split, which follows the announcement of a 54.1-percent increase in earnings in the first nine months of fiscal 1996 to $2.04 (corrects from $2.94) per share, up from $1.33 in 1995. Capitol Transamerica's board said the 50-percent stock dividens will be payable January 15 to shareholders of record December 31. The company plans to pay cash in lieu of fractional shares based on the closing price of the stock December 31.
Capitol Transamerica is an insurance holding company with operations in 35 states.
The company's stock lost 1/8 Thursday to close at 25-7/8.
